about: [C2] The jank walk's doors (WAVE_C §7.5), on the test bed: a gunman looking for a way to me goes through the shut doors between us as a man does - he reaches for each a step off (a door that would swing into him: a step back out of its sweep), it swings, its sound, through - never through a shut leaf, never pinned behind an open one (the grid has every leaf where it stands open); a locked door he never paths through and it holds. Me crouched behind the desk in room A, every door shut, one man in room B. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/guns_doors.json

steps.name: the title, BEGIN at the test bed
every door shut and open to him; one man in room B, the bar

steps.eval: (() => { for (const h of [...G.world.hoods.list]) G.removeHood(h); const house = G.stage.part('house'); for (const d of Object.values(house.doors)) { d.set(0); d.locked = false; } G.guns.covers.rebuild(); window.M = G.guns.spawn({ kind: 'pistol', at: { x: 3.0, z: -3.0 }, wait: 0 }); window.LOG = []; window.T0 = G.time; window.LEAF = 0; G.scripts.push(() => { const h = window.M, ai = G.ais.get(h); if (!ai || !h.alive) return; const S = ai.brain.S; const st = S.state + (S.door ? ':' + S.door.D.name + ':' + S.door.phase : ''); if (!LOG.length || LOG[LOG.length - 1][1] !== st) LOG.push([+(G.time - T0).toFixed(1), st, +h.pos.x.toFixed(2), +h.pos.z.toFixed(2)]); for (const d of Object.values(house.doors)) if (d.shut && d.dist(d.angle, h.pos.x, h.pos.z) < 0.12) window.LEAF++; }); return 'ok'; })()

steps.until: (() => { const h = window.M; return h.alive && (G.ais.get(h).brain.hasLine || (h.pos.x < -1.3 && h.pos.z < 1)); })()

steps.label: he opened his way through (a door stands open behind him)

steps.name: room A sealed: both its doors locked - he never paths through them; they hold

steps.eval: (() => { for (const h of [...G.world.hoods.list]) G.removeHood(h); G.health.reset(); const house = G.stage.part('house'); for (const d of Object.values(house.doors)) { d.set(0); d.locked = false; } house.doors.A1.locked = true; house.doors.A2.locked = true; G.guns.covers.rebuild(); window.M = G.guns.spawn({ kind: 'pistol', at: { x: 3.0, z: -3.0 }, wait: 0 }); window.LOG = []; window.T0 = G.time; window.LEAF = 0; return 'ok'; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const D = G.stage.part('house').doors; return D.A1.open01 < 0.05 && D.A2.open01 < 0.05 && window.LEAF === 0 && !(window.M.pos.x < -1.3 && window.M.pos.z < 1); })()
steps.label: the locked doors held; he is not in room A, never through a leaf
